fusions.name: Windward Rush
fusions.desc: You rush the target on a swelling gust, then strike for 16 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Crosswind
fusions.desc: Looses a broad gust that deals 28 damage to everything caught in it, ignoring resistances. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Tack Away
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Fair Wind
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 14%.
